name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
steps: Step one heel forward, lift those toes and soften the knee of the leg supporting your weight.
Place your hands lightly on your hips or the thigh of your slightly bent standing leg.
Hinge from your hips with a long back until you feel a gentle stretch behind your extended thigh.
Hold the stretch calmly with steady breaths on one side, then stand back upright and switch legs.
tips: Hinge cleanly at your hips with a neutral back rather than rounding your shoulders toward your foot.
Avoid pressing down directly on the kneecap of your extended leg.
